_rule: Four-domain schematic (author, 2026-10-14): one standard name per slot, each domain's native word kept beside it. Status is one of derived, measured, calculated, prediction, conjecture, candidate, open. 'candidate' = proposed and not tested; 'open' = nothing yet. FOUR_DOMAINS.md and its gap map are generated from this file by CANON/four_domains.py; never edit them by hand.

slots.name: Encoding surface
slots.definition: Where the irreversible record is written.

cosmos.native: cosmic horizon; for a black hole, its own horizon
cosmos.formula: area A of the apparent horizon, r_A = 1/H

qubits.formula: two-level record held across a gap hf
qubits.source: Ch. Each platform on its own gauge: qubits

chips.source: Ch. Landauer at the transistor gate

slots.name: Surface temperature T_s
slots.definition: The temperature the record actually sees.

qubits.formula: T_q (e.g. 35 mK, not the 15 mK fridge)

slots.name: Bit price e_bit
slots.definition: IAM's Law: the minimum cost of one classical bit.

cosmos.native: cost of a bit at the horizon

chips.formula: k_B T_j ln2 = 3.33e-21 J at 75 C

slots.name: Drive energy E_drive
slots.definition: The energy spent per event to write or hold the record.

cosmos.formula: Mc^2 (black hole: Mc^2 = 2 T_H S, Smarr)

slots.name: Mahaffey number M
slots.definition: Drive over the thermal quantum, M = E_drive / k_B T_s (App. E #47, #485).

cosmos.formula: candidate: M = S/k_B for the cosmic horizon (bits cost all its rest energy), about 2.3e122; black hole M = 2S/k_B

qubits.formula: M = hf / k_B T_q = 6.86 (5 GHz, 35 mK)

slots.name: Floor (left mark)
slots.definition: The lowest error a record can hold against thermal kicks at full drive.

cosmos.formula: S = A / 4 l_P^2: one nat per 4 l_P^2

chips.native: Landauer and reliability floors; Boltzmann wall
chips.formula: k_B T_j ln2; E_min = k_B T ln(1/p); swing (k_B T/q) ln10 = 60 mV/decade

slots.name: Balance law
slots.definition: How the held error is set: restore against loss.

cells.formula: eps = f/(f+g), E_hold = k_B T ln(g/f)

slots.name: Reference (the 1)
slots.definition: The state the gauge is read against.

chips.formula: the chip on one stated definition

slots.definition: Saturation: the surface can no longer hold a record.

cosmos.formula: local area bound filled; the cosmic horizon never saturates on observable timescales

cells.formula: coin flip, eps = 1/2 at every identity site, A = 4.26

slots.name: Writer (potential half)
slots.definition: What adds the record onto the surface.

cosmos.formula: geometric deposit, stored in spacetime curvature; |V|/2

slots.name: Eraser (kinetic half)
slots.definition: What frees the surface; the Landauer step.

qubits.formula: candidate: relaxation to |0> (T1) and active reset

chips.formula: candidate: reset of an unknown bit (CMOS erases at almost every gate)

slots.name: Virial partition
slots.definition: The two halves are equal: 2K + V = 0.

cells.formula: E_hold = ln D - ln 2 (removing the eraser halves the copy error)

slots.name: Virial ratio R
slots.definition: Total against the kinetic half; 2 at equilibrium.

qubits.formula: candidate: total gate-error loss / reset loss, from an error budget
